title: RUST_CODE.BBS · Sixty-four
venue: Arthur's site · drawn during Message Boards · never posted
logline: The banner's number goes down by one every night the strip looks — 64, 63, 62 — and the chorus on the desk is one fewer each morning. The strip counts what it can see: four, then three. The strip doesn't say where they go. The dog looks under the desk.

panels.composition: The banner: the number's last digit drawn as one shape less than before.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close on a green block banner on a screen with a two-digit number whose last shape has changed

panels.composition: The desk: three stick figures where there were four.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, three tiny stick figures on a desk with an empty space where a fourth stood
brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a dog peering under a desk

panels.composition: WOOD writing the count on a scrap: two shapes, then two shapes, then two shapes, each one less.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man writing a column of two-digit counts on a scrap of paper each one less than the last

art.line: digitized brush-pen on bristol; the stick figures in ballpoint; the screen as a gray rectangle with a banner in it
art.palette: muddy early-digital flats; the screen's phosphor green, once

notes: ACTIVE NODES going down. Where they go: not said.
